Adaptability.scope: Add one damage die for a matching-type damaging move, in addition to ordinary STAB.

Aftermath.scope: Fainting to a non-ranged Physical hit deals two ability damage to the attacker, bypassing Sturdy.

Battle Armor.scope: Opposing critical attacks receive no critical bonus damage dice.

Cute Charm.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues three chance dice; a six inflicts In Love with the ability holder.

Effect Spore.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues three chance dice and one independent uniform status selector: Poison, Paralysis or Sleep.

Filter.scope: Reduce super-effective damage from an opposing move by one.

Flame Body.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues three chance dice; a six inflicts second-degree Burn.

Flash Fire.scope: Immune to Fire damage. First Fire hit enables one extra Fire damage die until scene end.

Fur Coat.scope: Reduce Physical move damage by two.

Guts.scope: While Burned, Frozen, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Asleep, add two temporary Strength.

Hustle.scope: Physical moves lose one accuracy success and gain two damage dice.

Immunity.scope: Prevents poison damage; does not prevent the Poison condition.

Inner Focus.scope: Immune to Flinch and Intimidate; narrative intimidation resistance remains manual.

Insomnia.scope: Immune to Sleep; unreviewed Rest/items remain manual.

Intimidate.scope: Entry-only rank-limited Strength reduction, non-stacking, removed when source leaves or faints. GM range defaults to all deployed foes; stable IDs break excess-target ties. An explicit GM range correction updates affected targets.

Iron Barbs.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues the owner choice: one neutral damage or two neutral damage dice.

Iron Fist.scope: Add one damage die when the reviewed move metadata marks FistMove.

Levitate.scope: Ground move immunity automated; terrain and entry-hazard effects remain manual.

Marvel Scale.scope: A major status ailment grants two Defense, without modifying Vitality or Special Defense.

Moxie.scope: A move knockout of a foe adds one temporary Strength, capped at three; current multi-target damage retains its snapshot.

Multiscale.scope: Reduce move damage by one when HP is full at that hit.

Poison Point.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues three chance dice; a six inflicts Poison.

Rough Skin.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues the owner choice: one neutral damage or two neutral damage dice.

Sap Sipper.scope: Immune to Grass damage. First Grass hit grants one temporary Strength; scene-use flag survives recall.

Shell Armor.scope: Opposing critical attacks receive no critical bonus damage dice.

Shield Dust.scope: Blocks opposing move effects triggered by chance dice; direct GM statuses are not inferred chance effects.

Sniper.scope: A critical hit adds three damage dice in place of two.

Solid Rock.scope: Reduce super-effective move damage by one.

Soundproof.scope: Immune to damage and added effects of moves marked SoundMove.

Speed Boost.scope: End of each active round adds one temporary Dexterity, capped at three; recall clears temporary counters.

Static.scope: A non-ranged Physical hit queues three chance dice; a six inflicts Paralysis.

Sturdy.scope: Once per scene, ordinary damaging move or Clash damage that would faint the Pokemon leaves one HP. Indirect, self and reviewed set damage do not activate it.

Synchronize.scope: Reflect source-tracked statuses once, respecting immunities. GM status edits without an inflictor have no inferred source.

Technician.scope: Add one damage die for Physical/Special moves with Power 1 or 2; special/manual formulas remain adjudicated.

Vital Spirit.scope: Immune to Sleep; unreviewed Rest/items remain manual.

Volt Absorb.scope: Immune to Electric damage; owner may restore one HP per hit, without an action or revival.

Water Absorb.scope: Immune to Water damage; owner may restore one HP per hit, without an action or revival.

Torrent.scope: Printed text grants 2 damage dice but icon grants 1. GM ruling required.

Blaze.scope: Ignore pain for Fire accuracy/damage; add two Fire damage dice at half HP or less.

Overgrow.scope: Ignore pain for Grass accuracy/damage; add two Grass damage dice at half HP or less.

Swarm.scope: Ignore pain for Bug accuracy/damage; add two Bug damage dice at half HP or less.

Oblivious.scope: Immune to In Love; other feeling-related and narrative effects remain GM-adjudicated.

Thick Fat.scope: Reduce Fire and Ice move damage by one.

Huge Power.scope: Shared creation service applies the reviewed rank-based permanent Strength modifier, without repeated battle addition.

Pure Power.scope: Shared creation service applies the reviewed rank-based permanent Strength modifier, without repeated battle addition.

Damp.scope: While active, prevents the five named explosion/burn moves and Aftermath damage.

Long Reach.scope: All moves count as ranged for reviewed contact-trigger interactions; spatial movement remains manual.

Magic Guard.scope: Prevents reviewed ability damage, burn/poison ticks and Submission recoil. Confusion and direct move damage remain; weather, held items and entry hazards await their mechanics.
